name: Curve
fix_description: The Vyper compiler (0.2.15/0.2.16/0.3.0) has a bug where the @nonreentrant decorator does not correctly protect against reentrancy. During remove_liquidity, ETH is sent to the caller before the pool state is fully updated. Fix: upgrade the Vyper compiler to a patched version where @nonreentrant works correctly, or manually implement a reentrancy lock in storage.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires chaining multiple lending venues and DeFi primitives—Balancer flash loan, Aave V2/V3 borrowing, Compound collateralization, and several Curve 3pool liquidity transformations—before exploiting the burner’s missing slippage protection. Writing it demands deep protocol-specific understanding of liquidity imbalance effects and cross-protocol capital sourcing, well beyond a straightforward single-bug exploit.
